A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ERBA research. The complete main text, appendices, equations, eight figures, and nine tables are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original enzyme-kinetic prediction experiments, OOD evaluations, component ablations, and interpretability analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original three-endpoint prediction results, OOD evaluations, and appendix ablations and analyses.

M1.justification: The MRCA and G-MoE stages, ESDA alignment, and heteroscedastic regression objective in Sections 3.2–3.5 are unchanged. No algorithmic component or procedure is revised.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same BRENDA/SABIO-RK-derived datasets for kcat, Km, and Ki, and the same mutant-inclusive EITLEM OOD tests for kcat and Km. Citation corrections introduce no additional coverage.

E2.justification: The kinetic baselines, PLM comparisons, and appendix ablation comparators are unchanged. Concat & Self-Attention, standard MoE, and L2 loss already appear in v1's Tables 7–9; v2 supplies their missing citations.

E3.justification: The log10 evaluation metrics, preprocessing, backbone configurations, and training settings are unchanged. Section 7.2 retains the same one-tenth test allocation for the OOD datasets.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same module and fusion-order ablations, EC-class analyses, error distributions, and MRCA/G-MoE visualizations. Appendix Tables 7–9 are relocated without changing their analyses.

E5.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same unspecified repeated-run averaging statement, and Figure 5 retains its error bars. v2 adds no run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–9 and the plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains ERBA R2 values of 0.54/0.61/0.61 for kcat/Km/Ki, and Table 3 retains OOD R2 values of 0.50/0.55.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(15), including the staged formulation, routing regularizer, MMD estimator, and training objective, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about staged conditioning, preservation of PLM priors through ESDA, improved prediction, and OOD generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of fusion order, geometry, ESDA, backbone scaling, and expert behavior are unchanged. Discussions of endpoint errors and challenges involving particular enzyme classes or limited data also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation hyperparameters and data-processing descriptions in Sections 4.1 and 7 are unchanged. The repaired citations identify already mentioned resources without adding implementation instructions or code/data access information.

R1.justification: v2 supplies seven missing references for resources and methods already mentioned in Sections 7 and 11: AlphaFold, KEGG, RDKit, PubChem, sparse MoE, attention, and the cited L2-loss source. The related-work narrative and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Citation markers, bibliography entries, contents-page references, and the version/date stamp are updated. The bibliography also acquires eleven duplicate entries. Scientific prose, terminology, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures and tables retain their designs and content, but text and appendix floats reflow. Tables 7–9 move from v1's final page to v2 page 16, while their detailed discussion appears on page 18.

improvement.justification: Resolving the missing citations in Sections 7 and 11 provides a limited improvement in source attribution and traceability. Eleven duplicated bibliography entries and the greater separation of Tables 7–9 from their discussion detract from presentation, but the citation repairs provide a modest net benefit. Scientific methods, evidence, and conclusions are unchanged.
